spans.s:
The affix अण् comes after the words 1. विकर्ण 2. शुङ्ग and 3. छगल when the sense is a descendant of the family of वत्स , भारद्वाज and अत्रि , respectively.

Terms: अण्

The affix ढक् comes after the words 1. विकर्ण and 2. कुषीत when they mean the descendants of काश्यप।

Terms: ढक्

ष् is substituted for the स् of स्थल after वि , कु , शमि and परि।

Terms: ष change
